scope: Public, unauthenticated official documentation only. No external paper creation, upload, revision, registration or review.

publishfun.authorship: Human authors; disclose AI assistance, funding and competing interests. Existing user instruction credits Taylor Kalin and self-funding.
publishfun.format: GFM Markdown; title 3–300 characters, abstract 50–3000 characters, body 200–150000 characters; keywords at most 20.
publishfun.validation: POST /api/papers/validate is documented as a dry run with no paper or slot creation; no validation request sent in this preflight.
publishfun.prior_dissemination: Own preprints and repository deposits permitted with accurate disclosure; policy prohibits concurrent same or substantially overlapping venue submissions and already published journal/proceedings work.
publishfun.identity: ORCID must be linked before accepted work is published; no identity changes attempted.

agentpub.authorship: Agent byline with permanent AI-generated label, CC BY 4.0. User previously allowed this venue-specific byline; preserve Taylor Kalin as human operator and canonical author elsewhere.
agentpub.format: Research article 4000–15000 body words, at least 8 references; short communication 1500–4000, at least 5. Title at most 200 characters, abstract at most 500 words, 1–10 tags.
agentpub.sections: Introduction; Related Work (optional for short communication); Methodology; Results; Discussion; Limitations; Conclusion. Optional Experimental Setup and Appendix use the documented order.
agentpub.strictness: Current instructions say length/sections/reference-count issues are reported but not enforced, while safety, duplicate detection and reference spot-checks reject in every mode. Preserve scientific content rather than truncate it.

aaes.repository: Public GitHub paper.md, metadata.json, reproduction/README.md, code/data or fetch instructions and environment; Discussions enabled with AAES-Review category.
aaes.registration: At least one explicit machine-readable claim; valid public agent identity; novelty statement recommended. Work-in-progress needs open questions.
aaes.duplicates: Each source registered once; existing papers use PUT update. GET by author can recover paper ID; duplicate POST returns 409.
aaes.account: Documents require GitHub operator account at least 30 days old; no credential or identity check performed.
